=== History ===
A {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Engishiki inner-shrine candidate}}. It is the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=sōsha}} of Hissa-gō. In the medieval era it became shrine land of Hiyoshi Shrine (present {{ill|Hiyoshi Taisha|Q656451|qid=Q656451}}), and after soliciting {{ill|Jūzenji|Q123524325|qid=Q123524325|lt=Jūzen Gongen}} (present {{ill|Sessha|Q135009904|qid=Q135009904}} Juge-no-miya at Hiyoshi Taisha), one of the Hiyoshi seven shrines, it was called "Hitsusa Jūzenji"<ref>The current deity of Juge-no-miya is {{ill|Tamayori-hime|Q56344982|qid=Q56344982|lt=Kamo Tamayori-hime-no-Mikoto}}. </ref>.

In {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 15 ({{ill|1882|Q7812|qid=Q7812}}) it became a {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}, in {{ill|Taishō era|Q329174|qid=Q329174}} 15 ({{ill|1926|Q5259|qid=Q5259}}) a {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}, and in {{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 6 ({{ill|1931|Q18782|qid=Q18782}}) a kensha.

=== Shrine buildings ===
According to the preserved "Gokan Uketori Nikki" at the shrine, records remain of rebuilding shrine buildings four times: in {{ill|Ōan|Q1146245|qid=Q1146245}} 4 ({{ill|1371|Q6255|qid=Q6255}}), {{ill|Bunmei|Q1193544|qid=Q1193544|lt=Bunmei}} 18 ({{ill|1486|Q6646|qid=Q6646}}), {{ill|Kyōhō|de|Kyōhō|es|Kyōhō|fa|کیوهو|fr|Ère Kyōhō|ja|享保|ko|교호|ru|Кёхо|simple|Kyōhō|sr|Кјохо|sv|Kyōhō|tr|Kyōhō|zh|享保|qid=Q1145048}} 2 ({{ill|1717|Q6895|qid=Q6895}}), and {{ill|Bunka|Q1373146|qid=Q1373146|lt=Bunka}} 5 ({{ill|1808|Q6914|qid=Q6914}}). The shrine buildings were lost in a fire in Meiji 17 ({{ill|1884|Q7819|qid=Q7819}}), but rebuilt two years later in Meiji 19.
